210332751_baa80ff1.text: At least 26 different types of GABAergic interneurons have been identified in the hippocampus (Somogyi et al., 2004), and perhaps more in the cerebral cortex (Myers et al., 2007)(Habib et al., 2017). Differences in firing properties, connectivity patterns, and molecular expression profiles are hypothesized to contribute to nonoverlapping functions of the respective classes.
